description: Build a movement route from a named pattern (patrol/approach/flee/wander/custom) instead of raw move-command codes. Read-only: returns { moveRoute, warnings? }. Use the route as an event page’s autonomous moveRoute (update_map_event with moveType 3), or feed it to set_movement_route for a forced route in an event command list.

commands.description: custom only: raw move commands { code, parameters }

direction.description: patrol only: primary direction, walked out and back (default right)

pattern.description: patrol (walk a direction and back), approach (toward player), flee (away from player), wander (random), or custom (your own move commands)

repeat.description: Loop the route (patterns loop by default)

skippable.description: Skip a step when movement is blocked

wait.description: Wait for the route to finish before continuing

name: create_move_route
